Shipping Policy

Standard shipping usually takes 5 to 7 business days.

Tracking an order

Customers can track their orders from the Orders page
      using the tracking information provided after shipment.

Delayed shipments

If an order has not arrived within the expected delivery
      period, customers should contact support for assistance.

Returns and exchanges

You can manage returns and exchanges from the Orders page in your Shopify admin. When customers want to return items, you can create a return, send shipping instructions, and issue refunds after inspecting the returned items.

Returns usually involve the following actions:

Refund : Send the full or partial payment amount back to a customer.

Return : Receive an item back from a customer, with optional return shipping labels and tracking.

Exchange : Send a customer an alternative item as part of the return, such as a different size or color.

You can also activate self-serve returns and cancellations so customers can submit return or cancellation requests directly from their order status page. Customers can request to return delivered items, or cancel unfulfilled items before they ship. Return and cancellation rules let you control which items are eligible and how long customers have to make a request.
